why.mass_kg: A men's size 9 canvas sneaker weighs 300 to 400 g.
why.friction_static: Sole-up, the shoe lies on its canvas upper, and canvas slides on a table at about 0.35. Friction is averaged with the table's 0.5, so 0.2 here gives 0.35 there.
why.friction_dynamic: A little below Grip, as sliding friction is: 0.15 here gives about 0.33 on the table.
why.restitution: A shoe lands with almost no bounce.
why.linear_damping: Air barely slows a hand-sized object at the speeds the arms move it, so no extra drag (PhysX's default is 0 too).
why.angular_damping: PhysX's default spin drag (0.05 per second); raise it if a round object rolls away too easily.
why.scale: 1 keeps the size given at import (28.5 cm across), which should be the real object's.
why.collision: Decomposition keeps the sole's outline and the dip at the toe; one hull would fill them in.
